description: This file declares the TpmRandomSource class, which implements a secure random number generator using a TPM resource manager. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and provides methods for generating random data and adding entropy, intended for use with cryptographic operations like HMAC and AES.

classes.name: TpmRandomSource
classes.description: A class that provides a secure random number source backed by a TPM, inheriting from keymaster::RandomSource.

methods.name: TpmRandomSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the random source with a reference to a TpmResourceManager.

methods.name: GenerateRandom
methods.description: Generates random bytes and fills the provided buffer.

methods.name: AddRngEntropy
methods.description: Adds entropy to the RNG, possibly from external sources.
